definition: to draw to itself or oneself.

definition: to be mixed, smeared or covered with dust.

example_en: The sounds of all the instruments were in perfect harmony.

example_en: The teacher gave instructions to the disciples.

definition: a kind of jowar (millet).

example_en: This year they sowed the fulgara variety of jowar in large quantities.

definition: imagination - a) the act or power of forming mental images of what is not actually present, b) the act or power of creating mental images of what has never been actually experienced or of creating new images or ideas by combining previous experiences; creative power.
example_en: That artist's imagination was immense.

definition: a kind of medicinal plant.
example: ಆ ವನದಲ್ಲಿ ವಿಜಯ ಎಂಬ ಔಷಧೀಯ ಗಿಡ ಬೆಳೆಯುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The medicinal plant called vijaya grows in that forest.

definition: the concentrated, focussed mind.
example: ಒಬ್ಬುದ್ದಿಯಿಂದ ಓದಿದರೆ ವಿಷಯ ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿ ನೆನಪಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಉಳಿಯುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: If one studies with focused concentration, the subject is remembered well.

definition: to shoot (an arrow) as to cut an object into pieces.
example_en: The hunter shot an arrow to cut the tree into pieces.

example: ಹೈದರ್ ಅಲಿ ಆಳ್ವಿಕೆಯ ಕಾಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಮುಗ್ಗೊಳಿ ಎಂಬ ತೆರಿಗೆ ಜಾರಿಯಲ್ಲಿತ್ತು.
example_en: During Hyder Ali's rule, a tax called muggoli was in force.

definition: to save, protect (from a danger, difficult situation).
example_en: He saved the child from the fire.

example_en: A flock of swans is swimming in the lake.

definition: not changed; being as (one) was; not disturbed; maintaining the original from or quality.
example: ಅವನ ಸ್ವಭಾವ ವರ್ಷಗಳ ನಂತರವೂ ಅವಿಕೃತಿಯಾಗಿಯೇ ಉಳಿಯಿತು.
example_en: His nature remained unchanged even after years.

definition: to take; to receive in one's hand; to accept.

definition: name of a deity.
example: ಹಬ್ಬದಂದು ಜೋಕೊವರ ದೇವರಿಗೆ ವಿಶೇಷ ಪೂಜೆ ನಡೆಯಿತು.
example_en: A special worship was held for the deity Jokovara on the festival day.

definition: a large number of persons or things gathered, come in, brought together; a multitude; a crowd.

definition: any oil in its crude form; unrefined oil; crude oil.

definition: the condition or quality of being empty; emptiness.
example_en: The emptiness of that vessel was visible to everyone.

definition: the chief of an army; a military commander.
example: ದಳವಾಯಿ ರಾಜನ ಆಜ್ಞೆಯಂತೆ ಯುದ್ಧ ಸಿದ್ಧತೆ ಮಾಡಿದನು.

definition: a woman who is about to be married; a bride.
example_en: They adorned the bride and brought her to the wedding pavilion.

definition: a wild boar or swine (Sus scrofa).
example_en: The hunters chased the wild boar in the forest.

definition: (masc.) a skilled performer of gymnastic feats, that requires skilful control of the body, as walking on a tightrope or swinging on a trapeze; an acrobat.

definition: armour of iron netting.

definition: a footwear.

definition: to add, enhance the beauty; to make agreeable.

example_en: After the rain, water had filled the hollow in the ground.

definition: to fall down (by one's own weight); to collapse.
example_en: The old wall collapsed by its own weight.

definition: to try to find something; to make a search.
example_en: He searched everywhere for the lost key.

definition: the quality or condition of being dense, thickly populated; density.
example: ಈ ಪ್ರದೇಶದ ಜನಸಂಖ್ಯೆಯ ಸುಬ್ಬು ಬಹಳ ಹೆಚ್ಚಾಗಿದೆ.
example_en: The population density of this area is very high.

definition: a bundle of dry straw.
example: ರೈತ ಒಂದು ಬೈಸೂಡಿಯನ್ನು ಎತ್ತಿ ಗೋದಲಿಗೆ ಒಯ್ದನು.
example_en: The farmer lifted a bundle of dry straw and carried it to the cattle shed.

definition: the metal rim of a wheel; a felly.
example_en: The metal rim of the wheel is broken.

definition: to take place; to happen; to occur.
example_en: That accident took place on the road.

definition: a small utensil to take a liquid from a big container as a mug.
example_en: She scooped water from the pot with a mug.

definition: the tree Wrightia zeylanica ( = W. antidysentrica) of Apocynacoace family.
example_en: A Wrightia tree had grown in the courtyard.

definition: the jurisdiction or the territorial range of an administration.
example_en: This region falls within the chieftain's jurisdiction.

definition: to move forward by or as by crawling.
example: ಆತ ಗಾಯಗೊಂಡು ನೆಲದ ಮೇಲೆ ದೋಕುತ್ತಾ ಸಾಗಿದ.
example_en: He was injured and crawled forward on the ground.

definition: beauty of words or speech (of a person).
example: ಆ ಕವಿಯ ಕಾವ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ವಾಕ್ಶ್ರೀ ಎದ್ದು ಕಾಣುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The beauty of speech is evident in that poet's poetry.

definition: a master, owner or employer.
example: ಆ ಮನೆಯ ದನಿ ಬಡವರಿಗೆ ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: The master of that house helps the poor.

definition: absence or want of literariness.
example_en: The lack of literariness in that poem annoyed the readers.

definition: a man who putforths his opinion.
example_en: The advisor put forth his opinion in the meeting.

definition: a pink palm.
example: ಅವಳ ಕೆಂದಳ ಮದರಂಗಿಯಿಂದ ಇನ್ನಷ್ಟು ಕೆಂಪಾಗಿ ಕಂಡಿತು.
example_en: Her pink palm looked even redder with the henna.

definition: a narrative account; a statement; a description.
example_en: He wrote an account of his journey.

definition: an acute febrile contagious disease marked by the formation of a false membrane especially in the throat and caused by a bacterium (Corynebacterium diphtheriae) that produces a toxin causing inflammation of the heart and nervous system; diphtheria.
example: ಡಿಪ್ತೀರಿಯ ರೋಗದಿಂದ ಮಗುವಿನ ಗಂಟಲಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಪೊರೆ ಉಂಟಾಯಿತು.
example_en: Because of diphtheria, a membrane formed in the child's throat.

definition: a place where old, weak or protectionless cattle are given protection and shelter.
example_en: They sent the weak cattle to the animal shelter.

definition: the sky, the path of stars.
example_en: The path of stars in the sky was clearly visible at night.

definition: to make something big, large or bigger, larger.
example_en: He made his business bigger.

definition: that quality that tends or causes slipping or sliding, as ice, oil, a wet surface; slipperiness.
example_en: Slipperiness had come to the road because of the frost.

definition: to stick oneself to (as an adhesive).
example_en: The glue stuck to the cloth.

definition: to collapse; to break down; to fall down or aside.
example_en: The hut collapsed under the battering of the rain.

definition: a short, tapering iron bar, used in kitchens to pound from the blunt end.
example_en: They pounded the spice with the iron pestle bar in the kitchen.

definition: to look alike; to have a likeness or similarity to.
example_en: That boy resembles his own father.

definition: to include, contain (within oneself, one's sphere, range, jurisdiction, etc.).
example_en: This district includes many villages.

definition: to change; to alter; to transform; to convert.
example_en: Time transforms everything.
